clarifications.title: Tax Returns
clarifications.clarification: When formal tax returns are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that clearly demonstrates income amount, source, and continuity over time.

secondary_evidence.label: CPA or accountant income summary letter
secondary_evidence.description: Must be prepared by a licensed accountant.
should_state: Total income earned over the past 12 months
requirements: The letter should be signed, dated, and issued on professional letterhead.
Supporting documents may still be requested.

secondary_evidence.label: Year-end income statements
secondary_evidence.description: Annual summaries issued by an employer, platform, or accounting system.
notes: Informal or self-generated summaries may require additional review.

secondary_evidence.label: Platform annual payout summaries
secondary_evidence.description: Official annual earnings reports from recognized platforms.
notes: Screenshots without platform identification may not be sufficient.

clarifications.title: Invoices
clarifications.clarification: When formal invoices are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that demonstrates services rendered, payment terms, and income continuity.

secondary_evidence.label: Signed contracts
secondary_evidence.description: Executed agreements between the contractor and client.
requirements: Contracts should be signed and dated by both parties.

secondary_evidence.label: Client confirmation letters
secondary_evidence.description: Written confirmation from the client verifying the working relationship.
requirements: Letters should be signed and include client contact information.

secondary_evidence.label: Platform work records
secondary_evidence.description: Official records from freelance or contracting platforms (Upwork, Fiver, etc).
notes: Screenshots without platform identification may require additional review.

clarifications.title: Contracts
clarifications.clarification: When formal contracts are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that demonstrates an ongoing work relationship and income generation.

secondary_evidence.label: Invoices
secondary_evidence.description: Formal billing records issued to clients.
notes: Recurring invoices strengthen proof of continuity.

secondary_evidence.label: Client confirmation letters
secondary_evidence.description: Written confirmation from clients acknowledging the working relationship.
requirements: Letters should be signed and include client contact information.

secondary_evidence.label: Platform contracts or profiles
secondary_evidence.description: Official platform records showing active engagements.
must_include: Evidence of active or recent contracts
notes: Screenshots without platform identification may not be sufficient.

clarifications.title: Income History Duration
clarifications.clarification: Costa Rica’s Digital Nomad visa requires proof of income continuity for at least 12 months. If you can only document income for a shorter period, immigration authorities may not be able to confirm financial eligibility.

boundary.minimum_requirement: A minimum of 12 months of documented income is required.
boundary.case_by_case: Applications with less than 12 months of income history typically require additional review or legal guidance.
